notes.title: 0.1.1 Weekly Update 1 - Adventure Difficulty Optimization
notes.content:
Hello adventurers, our team has been working hard to address issues and feedback from the community. We have also re-examined the difficulty issue raised by some players. As we have been immersed in the development process for a long time and are very familiar with the game ourselves, we may not have done a very good job in controlling the difficulty. We apologize for any negative experience this may have caused. In this update, we have made several optimizations to address the difficulty issues in the game, hoping to improve the overall gameplay experience. We appreciate your support and feedback, and we hope you enjoy playing the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44176662/0afdf470e59c6165781f5fba241eaf4799e7f926.jpg[/img]

[h3]New Stuff[/h3]
[list]
[*]Introducing a new junior creature - the Jellyfish Baby
[*]Added three new monster-hunting commissions to the third adventure
[*]Added a crew member and a weapon before embarking on an adventure
[*]Added sonar usage instructions
[*]Added item usage effects description
[/list]
[h3]Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*]Optimized overall adventure difficulty
[*]Adjusted submarine durability values and upgrade curve
[*]Expanded submarine capacity and made equipped weapons and equipment not consume any capacity
[*]Adjusted loan interest rates
[*]Adjusted daily sailing time
[/list]

notes.title: 0.0.4 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed the issue of data abnormalities for users in certain regions
[/list]
This problem can cause the base speed value of the submarine, which is 2.0, to be presented as 20. It can also cause the speed value in overloaded situations to be multiplied by 0.5 and presented as multiplied by 5, and so on.

notes.title: 0.0.3 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed the issue where the submarine still moves in some paused situations
[*]Fixed the problem where using an item in the bar would result in an error
[*]Fixed the issue of distorted mouse cursor image in Windows environment
[/list]
Thank you to players [u]ForestGrump[/u] and [u]FeuerTeufelz[/u] for reporting the issue of abnormal submarine speed in the game under certain conditions. We now have some leads on the issue, and once we successfully make the necessary changes, we will release a new update as soon as possible.

notes.title: Deep Blue Fantasy Early Access is here!
notes.content:
Adventurers, are you ready? The Early Access is officially released today! Let's pack our bags and embark on a journey to the endless sea, and start the "Deep Blue Fantasy"! 

[h2][b]First release discount of 30% off, valid for one week only.[/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44176662/85051bf6c4cd1fd5cb7272bad6ef6ea702e3f6ce.jpg[/img]

The EA includes:
[list][b]
[*]Complete story and game progress
[*]4 different terrains with randomly generated maps of varying sizes
[*]Two races - Human and Merfolk, along with their respective submarines
[*]27 interesting achievements
[/b][/list]
Thank you for your attention and support, we hope you have a great time playing!

notes.title: Early Access begins Next Week!
notes.content:
[h2][b]Deep Blue Fantasy begins Early Access next week![/b][/h2]

If you are interested in our game! Please add us to your wishlist! We welcome everyone to experience it and provide valuable feedback. Follow us now so that we don't miss each other!


[h3]Early Access Features[/h3]

The current version can demonstrate the core gameplay of the entire game and succinctly expresses our overall game concept, including:
[list][b]
[*] 60 different weapons and equipment
[*] 26 different creatures and 200 unique battlefields
[*] 4 different types of marine terrain with 6 different exploration sites in each type
[/b][/list]
Please follow us, and tell your friends about us!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44176662/7ac31d9e881d0ac14476828a47e209f9ebf0777f.jpg[/img]
